SELECT AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog, AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react, 
       MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cog, MAX(reaction_ms) as max_react,
       MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cog, MIN(reaction_ms) as min_react
FROM measurements

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react,
        AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) as sum_cog_sq,
        AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) as sum_react_sq,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
    avg_cog,
    avg_react,
    sqrt(sum_cog_sq - avg_cog * avg_cog) as std_cog,
    sqrt(sum_react_sq - avg_react * avg_react) as std_react,
    cnt
FROM stats

WITH stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react,
        AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) as sum_cog_sq,
        AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) as sum_react_sq,
        COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    s.std_cog,
    s.std_react,
    (m.cognitive_score - s.avg_cog) / s.std_cog as cog_zscore,
    (m.reaction_ms - s.avg_react) / s.std_react as react_zscore
FROM measurements m
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE ABS(m.cognitive_score - s.avg_cog) > 2 * s.std_cog
   OR ABS(m.reaction_ms - s.avg_react) > 2 * s.std_react
ORDER BY cog_zscore DESC

args.query:
SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
    AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) - AVG(cognitive_score) * AVG(cognitive_score) as var_cog,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react,
    AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) - AVG(reaction_ms) * AVG(reaction_ms) as var_react,
    COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM measurements m
GROUP BY m.session_id, m.participant_id, m.condition, m.cognitive_score, m.reaction_ms
LIMIT 1

WITH overall_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
        AVG(cognitive_score * cognitive_score) as sum_cog_sq,
        AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react,
        AVG(reaction_ms * reaction_ms) as sum_react_sq
    FROM measurements
)
SELECT 
    m.session_id,
    m.participant_id,
    m.condition,
    m.cognitive_score,
    m.reaction_ms,
    os.avg_cog,
    sqrt(os.sum_cog_sq - os.avg_cog * os.avg_cog) as std_cog,
    os.avg_react,
    sqrt(os.sum_react_sq - os.avg_react * os.avg_react) as std_react,
    (m.cognitive_score - os.avg_cog) / sqrt(os.sum_cog_sq - os.avg_cog * os.avg_cog) as cog_zscore,
    (m.reaction_ms - os.avg_react) / sqrt(os.sum_react_sq - os.avg_react * os.avg_react) as react_zscore
FROM measurements m, overall_stats os
WHERE ABS(m.cognitive_score - os.avg_cog) > 2 * sqrt(os.sum_cog_sq - os.avg_cog * os.avg_cog)
   OR ABS(m.reaction_ms - os.avg_react) > 2 * sqrt(os.sum_react_sq - os.avg_react * os.avg_react)
ORDER BY cog_zscore DESC

CREATE TABLE cleaned_measurements AS
SELECT 
    session_id,
    participant_id,
    condition,
    cognitive_score,
    reaction_ms,
    recorded_at,
    status,
    notes
FROM measurements
WHERE ABS(cognitive_score - 74.03703703703704) <= 50.38953883637615
   AND ABS(reaction_ms - 413.5925925925926) <= 566.7927334956618;

SELECT 
    'cleaned' as source,
    COUNT(*) as count,
    AVG(cognitive_score) as avg_cog,
    AVG(reaction_ms) as avg_react,
    MIN(cognitive_score) as min_cog,
    MAX(cognitive_score) as max_cog
FROM cleaned_measurements
